slug: 2024-05-29 Marc-Andre Loko - Benin's digital strategy involves a diversified portfolio of partners

facts.fact: ASIN's director general described a 2021-2026 digital plan, successor to a 2016 plan built by Deloitte, shifting toward home-grown adoption of digital services with digital payments and financial inclusion the fastest-moving strand; the article names no adopting act and no date, so its published date of 2024-05-29 applies.

systems.tiers: national; the predecessor of the 2021-2026 plan, with no description of its content
